WITH PROD_SPEC AS ( SELECT PROD_KEY, WERKS, MACH_CD, -- 화면 출력용 문자열 포맷 TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(MSRM_DATE, 'YYYYMMDD'), 'YYYY-MM-DD') || ' ' || MSRM_TIME AS MSRM_DATE_STR,
-- [구간 시작일시] DATE 타입 변환 TO_DATE(MSRM_DATE || REPLACE(MSRM_TIME, ':', ''), 'YYYYMMDDHH24MI') AS START_DT,
-- [구간 종료일시] 다음 생산사양의 등록일시 (없으면 먼 미래 9999년) LEAD(TO_DATE(MSRM_DATE || REPLACE(MSRM_TIME, ':', ''), 'YYYYMMDDHH24MI'), 1, TO_DATE('99991231', 'YYYYMMDD')) OVER (PARTITION BY MACH_CD ORDER BY MSRM_DATE, MSRM_TIME) AS END_DT, -- PIVOT 결과 컬럼 매핑 (별칭을 명확히 NM, RT로 줄였습니다) -- 원료명 NVL 처리 (null이면 빈 문자열) NVL("1_NM", ' ') AS MAT_NM_1, NVL("1_QT", 0) AS USE_QTY_1, NVL("1_RT", 0) AS MIX_RATE_1, NVL("2_NM", ' ') AS MAT_NM_2, NVL("2_QT", 0) AS USE_QTY_2, NVL("2_RT", 0) AS MIX_RATE_2, NVL("3_NM", ' ') AS MAT_NM_3, NVL("3_QT", 0) AS USE_QTY_3, NVL("3_RT", 0) AS MIX_RATE_3, NVL("4_NM", ' ') AS MAT_NM_4, NVL("4_QT", 0) AS USE_QTY_4, NVL("4_RT", 0) AS MIX_RATE_4, NVL("5_NM", ' ') AS MAT_NM_5, NVL("5_QT", 0) AS USE_QTY_5, NVL("5_RT", 0) AS MIX_RATE_5, NVL("6_NM", ' ') AS MAT_NM_6, NVL("6_QT", 0) AS USE_QTY_6, NVL("6_RT", 0) AS MIX_RATE_6, NVL("7_NM", ' ') AS MAT_NM_7, NVL("7_QT", 0) AS USE_QTY_7, NVL("7_RT", 0) AS MIX_RATE_7, NVL("8_NM", ' ') AS MAT_NM_8, NVL("8_QT", 0) AS USE_QTY_8, NVL("8_RT", 0) AS MIX_RATE_8, -- 총사용량 합계 계산 (NVL("1_QT", 0) + NVL("2_QT", 0) + NVL("3_QT", 0) + NVL("4_QT", 0) + NVL("5_QT", 0) + NVL("6_QT", 0) + NVL("7_QT", 0) + NVL("8_QT", 0)) AS TOTAL_USE, -- 총비율 합계 계산 (NVL("1_RT", 0) + NVL("2_RT", 0) + NVL("3_RT", 0) + NVL("4_RT", 0) + NVL("5_RT", 0) + NVL("6_RT", 0) + NVL("7_RT", 0) + NVL("8_RT", 0)) || '%' AS TOTAL_RATE FROM ( -- 1. 데이터 소스 및 가상 순번 생성 SELECT PROD_KEY, WERKS, MACH_CD, MSRM_DATE, MSRM_TIME, MAT_NM, MIX_RATE, USE_QTY, MAT_SEQ FROM TB_QLT_PROD_SPEC A WHERE 1=1 AND A.WERKS = #{WERKS}
AND A.MSRM_DATE BETWEEN TO_DATE(#{SPEC_FROM}, 'YYYYMMDD') AND TO_DATE(#{SPEC_TO} || ' 235959', 'YYYYMMDD HH24MISS')
AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM TB_QLT_PROD_SPEC B WHERE B.WERKS = A.WERKS AND B.PROD_KEY = A.PROD_KEY AND B.KPGBN = 'LBKP' AND B.MAT_NM LIKE '%' || #{MAT_NM_LB} || '%' )
AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM TB_QLT_PROD_SPEC C WHERE C.WERKS = A.WERKS AND C.PROD_KEY = A.PROD_KEY AND C.KPGBN = 'NBKP' AND C.MAT_NM LIKE '%' || #{MAT_NM_NB} || '%' )
) -- 2. PIVOT 실행 (별칭을 짧게 NM, RT로 설정) PIVOT ( MAX(MAT_NM) AS NM, MAX(MIX_RATE) AS RT, MAX(USE_QTY) AS QT FOR MAT_SEQ IN (1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8) ) PVT -- 3. 정렬 ORDER BY MSRM_DATE DESC ) , QLT03 AS ( SELECT /*+ LEADING(W001 I001 Q020 Q021 M001 M014 M016 US I010 M012 M012_TRA) USE_NL(I001 Q020 Q021 M001 M014 M016 US I010 M012 M012_TRA) INDEX(W001 TB_WRK001_WERKS_PRFM_DT_index) INDEX(I010 TB_INV010_LOT_NO_M_IDX) NO_HASH_JOIN NO_MERGE_SJ */ PRD_END_DATE, Q020.PRC_SEQNO AS PRC_SEQNO, -- 1. 담당 및 시간 (TB_QLT020, TB_WRK001) TO_CHAR(Q020.MSRM_DATE, 'YYYYMMDD') AS MSRM_DATE, TO_NUMBER(TO_CHAR(Q020.MSRM_DATE, 'HH24')) AS TIME_HOUR, TO_NUMBER(TO_CHAR(Q020.MSRM_DATE, 'MI')) AS TIME_MIN, NVL(US.NMLAST, ' ') AS MSRM_NM, -- 또는 INSPR_ID NVL(W001.WRK_CLASS, ' ') AS WRK_CLASS,
-- 2. 제품 사양 (TB_WRK001, TB_INV001) NVL(M012.MACH_CD, ' ') AS MACH_CD, NVL(M012.MACH_NM, ' ') AS MACH_NM, NVL(M012_TRA.MACH_CD, ' ') AS MACH_CD_TRA, NVL(M012_TRA.MACH_NM, ' ') AS MACH_NM_TRA,
NVL(I010.LOT_NO, ' ') AS LOT_NO, NVL(I001.LOT_NO, ' ') AS LOT_NO_M, NVL(M001.MATNR, ' ') AS MATNR, NVL(M001.MATNR_NM, ' ') AS MATNR_NM,
-- 3. 측정값 및 기준치 (이미지 순서대로 전체 항목) -- [평량] NVL(MAX(CASE WHEN M014.INSP_ITEM_NM = '평량' THEN Q021.RST_VAL END), 0) AS BS_WGT, -- [백색도] NVL(MAX(CASE WHEN M014.INSP_ITEM_NM = '백색도' THEN Q021.RST_VAL END), 0) AS WHITE, -- [파열강도] NVL(MAX(CASE WHEN M014.INSP_ITEM_NM = '파열강도' THEN Q021.RST_VAL END), 0) AS BURST, -- [MD] NVL(MAX(CASE WHEN M014.INSP_ITEM_NM = 'MD' THEN Q021.RST_VAL END), 0) AS MD, -- [CD] NVL(MAX(CASE WHEN M014.INSP_ITEM_NM = 'CD' THEN Q021.RST_VAL END), 0) AS CD, -- [신장율] NVL(MAX(CASE WHEN M014.INSP_ITEM_NM = '신장율' THEN Q021.RST_VAL END), 0) AS ELONG, -- [두께] NVL(MAX(CASE WHEN M014.INSP_ITEM_NM = '두께' THEN Q021.RST_VAL END), 0) AS THICK FROM TB_WRK001 W001 JOIN TB_MAS001 M001 ON W001.WERKS = M001.WERKS AND W001.MATNR = M001.MATNR JOIN TB_INV001 I001 ON W001.WERKS = I001.WERKS AND W001.IND_BCD = I001.IND_BCD JOIN TB_QLT020 Q020 ON Q020.WERKS = I001.WERKS AND Q020.MATNR = I001.MATNR AND Q020.MSRM_DATE = I001.MSRM_DATE AND Q020.PRC_SEQNO = I001.PRC_SEQNO and Q020.INSP_ITEM_GRP_CD = 'H1' -- HL 합지롤 검사 and Q020.DOC_NO IS NULL -- 현업에서 사용중인 합지롤검사 랑 구분되는게 doc_no 뿐임 만약에 이걸로안되면 별도로 구분값을 insert 시켜서 그 값으로 구분짓게해야함 일단 DOC_NO JOIN TB_QLT021 Q021 ON Q021.WERKS = Q020.WERKS AND Q021.MATNR = Q020.MATNR AND Q021.MSRM_DATE = Q020.MSRM_DATE AND Q021.PRC_SEQNO = Q020.PRC_SEQNO AND Q021.INSP_ITEM_GRP_CD = Q020.INSP_ITEM_GRP_CD JOIN TB_MAS014 M014 ON M014.INSP_ITEM_GRP_CD = Q021.INSP_ITEM_GRP_CD AND M014.INSP_ITEM_CD = Q021.INSP_ITEM_CD AND M014.PROD_GRP_CD = FN_GET_PROD_GRP(#{WERKS}, '') AND M014.USE_YN = 'Y' LEFT JOIN TB_MAS016 M016 ON Q021.WERKS = M016.WERKS AND Q021.MATNR = M016.MATNR AND Q021.INSP_ITEM_GRP_CD = M016.INSP_ITEM_GRP_CD AND Q021.INSP_ITEM_CD = M016.INSP_ITEM_CD LEFT JOIN USRMA US ON US.NMLAST = Q020.MSRM_ID LEFT JOIN TB_INV010 I010 ON I010.WERKS = I001.WERKS AND I010.LOT_NO_M = I001.LOT_NO LEFT JOIN TB_MAS012 M012 ON M012.MACH_CD = I001.MACH_CD LEFT JOIN TB_MAS012 M012_TRA ON M012_TRA.MACH_CD = I010.MACH_CD WHERE 1=1 AND NVL(W001.CNL_YN, 'N') = 'N'
AND W001.WERKS = #{WERKS}
AND W001.PRFM_DT BETWEEN TO_DATE(#{SPEC_FROM}, 'YYYYMMDD') AND TO_DATE(#{SPEC_TO} || ' 235959', 'YYYYMMDD HH24MISS')
AND W001.MACH_CD = #{MACH_CD}
AND W001.LOT_NO = #{LOT_NO}
AND M001.MATNR_NM like '%' || #{MATNR_NM} || '%'
GROUP BY Q020.MSRM_DATE, Q020.PRC_SEQNO, US.NMLAST, W001.WRK_CLASS, I001.LOT_NO, M001.MATNR, MATNR_NM, Q020.FNL_JDGM, Q020.RMK, W001.WIDTH, M012_TRA.MACH_NM, M012.MACH_NM, M012.MACH_CD, M012_TRA.MACH_CD , PRD_END_DATE, I010.LOT_NO order by I001.LOT_NO ) , QLT05 AS ( SELECT /*+ LEADING(W001 I001 Q020 Q021 M001 M014 M016 US M012 M012_TRA) USE_NL(I001 Q020 Q021 M001 M014 M016 US M012 M012_TRA) INDEX(W001 TB_WRK001_WERKS_PRFM_DT_index) NO_HASH_JOIN NO_MERGE_SJ */ PRD_END_DATE, Q020.PRC_SEQNO AS PRC_SEQNO, -- 1. 담당 및 시간 (TB_QLT020, TB_WRK001) TO_CHAR(Q020.MSRM_DATE, 'YYYYMMDD') AS MSRM_DATE, TO_NUMBER(TO_CHAR(Q020.MSRM_DATE, 'HH24')) AS TIME_HOUR, TO_NUMBER(TO_CHAR(Q020.MSRM_DATE, 'MI')) AS TIME_MIN,
NVL(W001.WRK_CLASS, ' ') AS WRK_CLASS,
-- 2. 제품 사양 NVL(W001.MACH_CD, ' ') AS MACH_CD, NVL(M012.MACH_NM, ' ') AS MACH_NM, NVL(I001.LOT_NO, ' ') AS LOT_NO, NVL(M001.MATNR_NM, ' ') AS MATNR_NM,
-- 3. 측정값 및 기준치 (이미지 순서대로 전체 항목) -- [직경] NVL(MAX(CASE WHEN M014.INSP_ITEM_NM = '직경' THEN Q021.RST_VAL END), 0) AS DIAM, -- [감축율] NVL(MAX(CASE WHEN M014.INSP_ITEM_NM = '감축율' THEN Q021.RST_VAL END), 0) AS RED_RATE, -- [평량] NVL(MAX(CASE WHEN M014.INSP_ITEM_NM = '평량' THEN Q021.RST_VAL END), 0) AS BS_WGT_TRA, -- [파강] NVL(MAX(CASE WHEN M014.INSP_ITEM_NM = '파열강도' THEN Q021.RST_VAL END), 0) AS BREAK, -- [절취강도] NVL(MAX(CASE WHEN M014.INSP_ITEM_NM = '절취강도' THEN Q021.RST_VAL END), 0) AS CUT_STR, -- [두께평균] NVL(MAX(CASE WHEN M014.INSP_ITEM_NM = '두께' THEN Q021.RST_VAL END), 0) AS THK_AVG, -- [테일강도] NVL(MAX(CASE WHEN M014.INSP_ITEM_NM = '테일실강도' THEN Q021.RST_VAL END), 0) AS TAIL_STR FROM TB_WRK001 W001 JOIN TB_MAS001 M001 ON W001.WERKS = M001.WERKS AND W001.MATNR = M001.MATNR JOIN TB_INV001 I001 ON W001.WERKS = I001.WERKS AND W001.IND_BCD = I001.IND_BCD JOIN TB_QLT020 Q020 ON Q020.WERKS = I001.WERKS AND Q020.MATNR = I001.MATNR AND Q020.MSRM_DATE = I001.MSRM_DATE AND Q020.PRC_SEQNO = I001.PRC_SEQNO and Q020.INSP_ITEM_GRP_CD = 'H3' -- HL 완제품 검사(물성) JOIN TB_QLT021 Q021 ON Q021.WERKS = Q020.WERKS AND Q021.MATNR = Q020.MATNR AND Q021.MSRM_DATE = Q020.MSRM_DATE AND Q021.PRC_SEQNO = Q020.PRC_SEQNO AND Q021.INSP_ITEM_GRP_CD = Q020.INSP_ITEM_GRP_CD JOIN TB_MAS014 M014 ON M014.INSP_ITEM_GRP_CD = Q021.INSP_ITEM_GRP_CD AND M014.INSP_ITEM_CD = Q021.INSP_ITEM_CD AND M014.PROD_GRP_CD = FN_GET_PROD_GRP(#{WERKS}, '') AND M014.USE_YN = 'Y' LEFT JOIN TB_MAS016 M016 ON Q021.WERKS = M016.WERKS AND Q021.MATNR = M016.MATNR AND Q021.INSP_ITEM_GRP_CD = M016.INSP_ITEM_GRP_CD AND Q021.INSP_ITEM_CD = M016.INSP_ITEM_CD LEFT JOIN TB_MAS012 M012 ON M012.MACH_CD = W001.MACH_CD WHERE 1=1 AND NVL(W001.CNL_YN, 'N') = 'N'
AND W001.WERKS = #{WERKS}
AND W001.PRFM_DT BETWEEN TO_DATE(#{SPEC_FROM}, 'YYYYMMDD') AND TO_DATE(#{SPEC_TO} || ' 235959', 'YYYYMMDD HH24MISS')
GROUP BY Q020.MSRM_DATE, Q020.PRC_SEQNO, Q020.MSRM_ID, W001.WRK_CLASS, W001.MACH_CD, I001.LOT_NO, I001.MATNR, Q020.FNL_JDGM, Q020.RMK, M012.MACH_NM, M001.MATNR_NM, PRD_END_DATE order by I001.LOT_NO ) SELECT * FROM PROD_SPEC PS LEFT OUTER JOIN QLT03 ON PS.MACH_CD = QLT03.MACH_CD AND QLT03.PRD_END_DATE >= PS.START_DT AND QLT03.PRD_END_DATE < PS.END_DT LEFT OUTER JOIN QLT05 ON QLT03.MACH_CD_TRA = QLT05.MACH_CD AND QLT03.LOT_NO = QLT05.LOT_NO ORDER BY PS.START_DT, QLT03.PRD_END_DATE, QLT05.PRD_END_DATE
